text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before Satono Diamond's first G1 race, her parents call her to cheer her on

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's parents have contributed much to the world of Umamusume, so she'd like to reward them with a G1 victory.
